title: Stack Constructions and Equality Cases for Laffey's Bound for Maximal Commutative Matrix Algebras
summary: Let $A\subseteq M_n(K)$ be a local maximal commutative algebra whose radical satisfies $J^3=0$. Laffey obtained a sharp lower bound for $\dim A$ in terms of the three Loewy-layer dimensions and constructed an infinite family of equality cases. We introduce a stacking operation which combines self-centralizing cube-zero algebras with common outer Loewy layers and preserves maximal commutativity.
